info.title: FluentCRM API
info.description: Complete REST API documentation for FluentCRM — a self-hosted email marketing and CRM plugin for WordPress.

get.description:
Daily unsubscribe counts for a date range, ready to plot as a time series.

`stats` is a **map keyed by date** (`YYYY-MM-DD`), not an array. Every day in the range is present, including days with no unsubscribes, so the series has no gaps.

`date_range` is a two-element array: `date_range[0]` is the start and `date_range[1]` the end. Omitting it falls back to the reporting service's default window.

<!-- fc:access -->

**Required capability:** `fcrm_view_dashboard`

_Enforced by `ReportPolicy::verifyRequest()`, the policy default for this route group._

<!-- /fc:access -->

parameters.name: date_range[]
parameters.description: Two-element range as `[from, to]`, each `YYYY-MM-DD`. Omit for the default window.

stats.description: Date-keyed counts. Every day in the range is present, zero-filled.

401.description: Not authenticated — missing or invalid credentials.

403.description: Authenticated but the user lacks the capability this route requires.
